packs.title: Audi Q4 e-tron
packs.content:
The fully electric Audi Q4 e-tron is the entry model to Audi’s electrified portfolio, with progressive design, smart utility and cutting-edge technology. Approachable and livable with spacious interior dimensions and the sophistication and quality for which Audi is known, the Q4 e-tron brings premium electric mobility to the heart of the market.

First introduced for model year 2022, mid-model-year updates in 2024 (Q4 55 e-tron) and 2025 (Q4 45 e-tron) added more power, range, and a more dynamic suspension tune. Model year 2025 also saw the previously optional Technology package (Audi virtual cockpit plus, Audi MMI Navigation plus, Traffic sign recognition, and Audi connect) made standard across the Q4 e-tron lineup, along with newly available Sport and Cold weather packages for the Q4 55 e-tron.

For model-year 2026, the Q4 lineup carries forward with minor trim-level content changes. Now standard on Premium Plus trims are Park assist plus, Top view camera and SONOS sound system. Available on the 2026 Q4 55 e-tron, a new Vision package includes the Head-up display, matrix-design LED headlights with DRL, and headlight washers, and the Black optic package now includes black exterior trim with black Audi rings and badges.

releases.title: Audi 2026 lineup launches with Audi Signature Care Scheduled Maintenance included on all models
releases.excerpt: As part of the most comprehensive product launch cadence in its history, Audi of America today announces pricing and equipment updates for its 2026 model lineup, as well as including scheduled maintenance to provide customers with additional value and peace of mind.
releases.content:
Updated August 3, 2026

  • Audi adds more equipment for 2026 model year, providing customers with further improved value
  • Audi Signature Care adds scheduled maintenance to comprehensive new-vehicle limited warranty suite and included 4-year Roadside Assistance coverage
  • Audi Signature Care includes all scheduled maintenance services in the first three years/30,000 miles of ownership

RESTON, Va., Aug. 21, 2025 – As part of the most comprehensive product launch cadence in its history, Audi of America today announces pricing and equipment updates for its 2026 model lineup, as well as including scheduled maintenance to provide customers with additional value and peace of mind. With a commitment to making the luxury ownership experience as seamless as possible, Audi Signature Care Scheduled Maintenance is now included with the purchase of all new 2026 model year vehicles. Audi Signature Care includes each of the new-vehicle scheduled services in the first three years/30,000 miles of ownership (whichever occurs first), as well as one brake fluid service, making a new Audi an even more compelling purchase in the premium segment.

Audi Signature Care service is honored at all authorized Audi dealerships in the United States, including its territories, and it’s in addition to the already comprehensive suite of warranty and roadside assistance coverage. Every new 2026 model year Audi now includes:

  • Audi Signature Care scheduled maintenance at 1yr/10K, 2yr/20K, and 3yr/30K (whichever occurs first) intervals
  • 4 Years/50,000 miles (whichever occurs first) New Vehicle Limited Warranty
  • 12 Year Limited Warranty Against Corrosion Perforation
  • 4 Year Roadside Assistance coverage

By making maintaining a vehicle as easy as setting up an appointment, an included scheduled maintenance program provides owners with additional peace of mind, helping further separate Audi from competitors by adding additional value within the premium segment. Audi Signature Care applies to both purchased and leased model-year 2026 models, and all service is completed by Audi-trained technicians at authorized dealers using factory procedures, specialized tools, and Audi Genuine Parts – helping to ensure an owner’s Audi continues to perform at its best.

Owners of any eligible Audi model wishing to further extend the coverage timeframes of scheduled maintenance – of Audi Signature Care or any of the Audi Care pre-paid service options – can do so easily with Audi Care Select. Available via any authorized U.S. Audi Dealer or within an owner’s myAudi online account, available Audi Care Select packages can provide extended service options up to 120,000 miles. For additional details, see the Audi Care website: Audi Care Updates | Audi USA

Along with the now included Audi Signature Care, updates and pricing for the 2026 Audi model lineup follow below, with information on additional 2026 models to be added in the coming weeks:

A3 Model Family
The 2026 Audi A3 family includes the A3 quattro, S3 and RS 3 sedans. The A3/S3 and RS 3 each saw extensive refreshes for model year 2025 as part of significant mid-cycle product improvements, so beyond the now included Audi Signature Care schedule maintenance, changes for 2026 models include new standard features and trim-level enhancements.

For the 2026 Audi A3, the previously available Technology Package contents – including the 12.3-inch Audi virtual cockpit plus, Audi MMI navigation plus, traffic sign recognition, a three-year Audi connect PLUS subscription, and access to the Audi App store – are now standard. A top-view camera and Park assist plus are now included in the Premium Plus trim level, which now also offers an S line plus package. This package offers an exclusive Daytona Gray pearl effect exterior color, provides a 15mm-lower sport suspension, 18" 5-Y-double-spoke design black metallic finish wheels, black exterior trim with Anthracite Audi rings, Sport front seats with S embossing, a black headliner and Aluminum spectrum dark interior inlays.

Changes to the S3 include the previously available Technology Package contents (12.3-inch Audi virtual cockpit plus, Audi MMI navigation plus, traffic sign recognition, a three-year Audi connect PLUS subscription, access to the Audi App store) becoming standard, along with an Auto-dimming interior mirror with compass and HomeLink®, a SONOS® Premium sound system with 3D sound, and a three-month free trial of SiriusXM® w/360L. New optional S3 equipment for model-year 2026 includes 19” 5-arm-star design bicolor finish wheels, and a new Driver assistance plus package containing the Head-up display (HUD), top view camera, park assist plus, and adaptive cruise assist with lane guidance.

Changes to the 2026 RS3 include making the content of the RS technology package (Head-up display, Traffic sign recognition, Audi MMI navigation plus) standard.

• Audi Q4 e-tron, A3, A6, Q3, and Q5 make updated list of used vehicles intended to help families prioritize vehicle safety while on a budget
  • Selection of Audi vehicles all feature standard stability control and other safety-enhancing features geared towards newer drivers
  • Audi Q4 e-tron only EV to earn spot in the Best Choices for midsize SUVs, and one of only three EVs out of 122 used vehicles to make the list

RESTON, Va., May 1, 2025 – Five Audi models have earned spots on an updated list of suggested vehicles for teens from the Insurance Institute for Highway Safety (IIHS) and Consumer Reports (CR), including the Audi Q4 e-tron, A3, A6, Q3 and Q5. The annual list of teen vehicles, which CR and IIHS has produced jointly since 2020, is intended to help families prioritize safety while maintaining a budget. The recommended vehicles are selected using a host of criteria including standard safety-enhancing features, IIHS crash-testing scores, braking and handling performance, ease of operability, and Kelly Blue Book estimated starting prices.

All of the recommended vehicles have earned “Good” ratings in five IIHS tests: original moderate overlap front, original side, driver-side small overlap front, roof strength and head restraints. Models in the top tier of used vehicles, designated as Best Choices, come with headlights that earn a good or acceptable rating from IIHS across all trim levels, along with standard automatic emergency braking (AEB) that performs well in IIHS track tests. They also have average or better scores from CR for braking and for emergency and routine handling (scoring at least 3 out of 5) and CR usability scores for controls and displays of at least 2 out of 5.

The Audi vehicles making the updated list include:

Best Choices – starting under $20,000

  • MIDSIZE SUVS: Audi Q4 e-tron (2022 or newer)

Good Choices – starting at $10,000 or less

  • MIDSIZE CARS: Audi A3 (2015 or newer)
  • LARGE CARS: Audi A6 (2016 or newer; only vehicles built after January 2015)
  • SMALL SUVS: Audi Q3 (2015 or newer)
  • MIDSIZE SUVS: Audi Q5 (2015 or newer; only vehicles built after January 2015)

For more details about the extensive set of selection criteria, see the joint IIHS and Consumer Reports release, here.

  • Comprehensive packages for several model lines add value while delivering fresh appeal
  • New Audi connect offer structure for 2025 extends included Audi connect NAV trial subscription from six months to three years
  • Reduction in 2025 model-year trim selections adapt inventory to customer needs

RESTON, Va., July 10, 2024 – Audi of America today announced pricing and content updates for its 2025 model lineup that includes new streamlined trim selections, compelling option packages, and a new Audi connect offer structure. The 2025 model year changes help bolster Audi’s momentum in the premium and electrified segments, cementing the brand’s reputation as a manufacturer of innovative vehicles.

An overall reduction in 2025 model complexity helps buyers focus their purchasing search. Several newly available trim and equipment packages for the Q3, Q5, A4, A5, and A6 increase value while elevating their appeal.

Expanded tech availability
For 2025, the Audi connect NAV trial subscription is increased from six months to three years. Audi’s integrated in-vehicle App Store is now included with Audi connect PLUS, allowing a wide range of apps including favorites such as Spotify, YouTube, Zoom and WhatsApp to be directly downloaded to the Multimedia Interface (MMI). This capability expands to more of the lineup, and now includes the A3 and Q7, along with Q4 e-tron and Q8 e-tron models.

Audi Themes – featuring stunning wallpaper images available to purchase for the MMI screen and paired with coordinated ambient lighting – expands to Audi Themes Plus, adding a matching audio element and image for the 3D Navigation display. For added convenience, Homelink® garage door buttons are now directly integrated into rearview mirror for most of the 2025 Audi model portfolio.

A3 Model Family
The 2025 A3 family, which includes the A3 quattro and S3 sedans, sees an extensive freshening with all models now arriving with standard quattro® all-wheel drive as part of a mid-cycle product improvement.

With quattro now standard on the A3, the model also receives a 15 lb.-ft. increase in engine torque to 236 lb.-ft., reducing the 0-60 mph time by 0.3 seconds (to 6.0 seconds). All A3 models also benefit from a sharpened exterior design, extended standard equipment, new interior materials and access to the Audi app store that permits popular apps to be loaded directly into Audi’s Multimedia Interface (MMI). The S3 sees substantial increases in performance with a 22-horsepower increase, chassis upgrades, and the addition of an advanced torque splitter – first introduced for the Nürburgring lap-record holding RS 3.

• New suspension and steering tuning with Audi DNA for improved driving dynamics and ride comfort
  • Q4 55 e-tron nets 40-horsepower increase over Q4 50 e-tron, dropping 0-60 mph time by nearly a second
  • Quicker DC fast charging from 10-80% in approximately 28 minutes through improved maximum charging power

RESTON, Va., March 7, 2024 – At a time when others are entering the segment, Audi is systematically continuing its course for growth of its fully electric vehicles, introducing comprehensive updates to its premium e-tron entry models. Mid-way through the 2024 model year, the Q4 50 e-tron becomes the Q4 55 e-tron and has been further infused with dynamic Audi DNA – offering a newly revised suspension and steering tune, increased range, and a sharper look with an available 21” wheel. Optimized chassis performance and higher-power charging capabilities designed to support the seamless transition toward electrification make it an even more engaging choice for buyers looking for a competent daily driver.

Battery performance updates
All 2024 Q4 55 e-tron models feature an 82 kWh (gross) battery that provides 77 kWh of net energy. Audi engineers have optimized cell chemistry to increase the DC fast-charging capabilities so that they replenish from 10 to 80 percent in about 28 minutes under normal conditions. The Q4 55 e-tron quattro now achieves a maximum DC charging power of 175 kW, up from 150 kW for the Q4 50 e-tron.

The e-tron’s route planner also prioritizes public DC fast-charging facilities and will thermally precondition the battery to ensure it charges as quickly as possible once connected at the station. For the first time, the Audi Q4 55 e-tron also features post-conditioning where the vehicle’s thermal management system cools the battery if it exceeds a defined temperature threshold after driving or charging.

Higher efficiency, more power and increased range
Audi has injected real performance into the updated Q4 55 e-tron, which not only benefits from superior power delivery and improved ride comfort, but also an increased driving range. The 2024 Q4 55 e-tron achieves an EPA estimated range of 258 miles – an additional 22 miles over the 2024 Q4 50 e-tron SUV. The 2024 Audi Q4 e-tron 55 also features an updated permanently excited synchronous (PSM) electric motor on the rear axle for higher efficiency and greater power.

The 2024 Audi Q4 55 e-tron and Q4 Sportback 55 e-tron now produce a maximum of 335 horsepower from their ASM/PSM (F/R) motors, an increase of 40 horsepower when compared to the 2024 Q4 50 e-tron and 2024 Q4 Sportback 50 e-tron. Channeled through its standard quattro® all-wheel-drive system, the additional power nets a nearly one-second drop (5.0 vs 5.8) in its 0-60 mph sprint.

The new rear electric motor also uses optimized thermal management for greater efficiency. Due to the geometry and arrangement of the gear wheels in the transmission, as well as specially shaped components for transporting and distributing the oil, temperatures in the powertrain remain stable. The cooling circuit, in turn, ensures the oil is temperature controlled. Contributing to the improved thermal management capabilities, is the inclusion of a water-cooling jacket on the outside of the stator.

Steering response improved along with ride comfort
In keeping with the Audi brand’s DNA, the new tuning for the suspension improves the balance for even greater comfort, dynamic driving, and stability. The steering characteristics and suspension tuning have been specially adapted for the occasion – the result is harmonious damping, improved steering response, and tighter load control.

The new suspension and steering tuning provide a more balanced, direct driving experience for which Audi is known. The Audi Q4 55 e-tron responds more immediately to steering changes for greater sportiness and agility. Additionally, it now offers a new 21” wheel package wrapped in 235/45 R21 front and 255/40 R21 rear all-season tires for an even sportier appearance.

Availability in spring 2024
Customers can configure their 2024 Audi Q4 55 e-tron models at audiusa.com today. The 2024 Q4 55 e-tron models are anticipated to arrive in U.S. showrooms in April 2024.

packs.content:
The fully electric Audi Q4 e-tron is the entry model to Audi’s electrified portfolio, with progressive design, smart utility and cutting-edge technology. Approachable and livable with spacious interior dimensions and the sophistication and quality for which Audi is known, the Q4 e-tron brings premium electric mobility to the heart of the market.

First introduced for model year 2022, mid-model-year updates in 2024 (Q4 55 e-tron) and 2025 (Q4 45 e-tron) added more power, range, and a more dynamic suspension tune. Model year 2025 also saw the previously optional Technology package (Audi virtual cockpit plus, Audi MMI Navigation plus, Traffic sign recognition, and Audi connect) made standard across the Q4 e-tron lineup, along with newly available Sport and Cold weather packages for the Q4 55 e-tron.

For model-year 2026, the Q4 lineup carries forward with minor trim-level content changes. Now standard on Premium Plus trims are Park assist plus, Top view camera and SONOS sound system. Available on the 2026 Q4 55 e-tron, a new Vision package includes the Head-up display, matrix-design LED headlights with DRL, and headlight washers, and the Black optic package now includes black exterior trim with black Audi rings and badges.
